title: The Maharashtra Project Affected Persons Rehabilitation Act, 1999

Long Title: An Act to consolidate and amend the law relating to the rehabilitation of persons affected by certain projects in the State of Maharashtra and for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto. Ministry: Ministry of Govt of Maharashtra Department: Revenue & Forest Department Type: STATE Location: Maharashtra Schedule 1.
